DevPulse for VS Code {{VERSION}}. It tracks your coding time privately and syncs it with your
account at https://devpulse-three-amber.vercel.app.

## Install

1. Download **devpulse-{{VERSION}}.vsix** below.
2. In VS Code, open the Extensions view, click **⋯**, choose **Install from VSIX…** and select the
   file. Or run: `code --install-extension devpulse-{{VERSION}}.vsix`
3. Sign in at https://devpulse-three-amber.vercel.app, go to **Settings → Integrations** and click
   **Generate connection key**.
4. In VS Code, run **DevPulse: Connect Account** and paste the key.

Requires VS Code 1.90 or newer. DevPulse sends coding metadata only, never source code, file
contents or keystrokes.
